The two changes under test: the record carries escape sequences (1 of 126 tools in this interval, 3 of 108 in a second session) and 0 raw ESC bytes reach any drawn body, target or input; and no fold row reads "0 tool uses" any more — that row was seen in this same view before the fix and is what the fold-decision change removed.

Method note worth keeping: a DOM check of /\[[0-9;]*m/ is NOT an escape check — it matches ordinary prose ("[[node-id]]") and source text quoting an escape, and reported 6 false hits here. The honest assertion is the raw ESC byte on the page, paired with the record's own escape count from the API.
